# Boost libraries whose headers libthrift needs: the closure that Boost's
# CMake computes for algorithm, locale, numeric_conversion, smart_ptr,
# tokenizer and uuid (docs/implementation/build-system.md, section 3.2).

# when Thrift or Boost is updated.
